title: Wild Horse Nine Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 90
rules: If Wild Horse Nine has a Tomatometer score of above 90 on Nov 9, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Wild Horse Nine sits at 93% (88 fresh, 7 rotten) about two weeks before its Nov 6 wide release, and Metacritic shows 79 with zero negative reviews. Wide-release reviews usually pull festival scores down by 1-2 points, and recent reviews have been about 87% fresh, so the final score probably lands around 91-92%. That is only just above the 90 line.
blind.falsifier: A wave of mixed or negative US critic reviews at the Nov 6 release pushes the displayed Tomatometer to 90% or lower by Nov 9.

final.reasoning: The 0.875 price led me to raise my estimate somewhat, since films like Banshees held their festival scores. But at 92.6% the buffer above the 91 display threshold is only about 2 points, recent reviews are about 87% fresh, and release-week critics usually pull scores down. I still think the market overrates YES.
